systems.country_label: CommCare, the only nationally recognised electronic community health information system
systems.owner: Ministry of Public Health, which adopted it; introduced by USAID in 2017 and supported by the USAID ACCESS programme (MSH, Dimagi), with servers acquired for local hosting
systems.tiers: community health volunteers and heads of health centres, more than 4,300 users at May 2024; volunteers' Monthly Activity Reports are integrated into the national health information management system
not stated; receives CommCare community data

note: The only system described is a community health worker application (class community), which the document says feeds volunteers' monthly reports into the national health information management system; that national system is named but not described, so no fact.
